description:
Lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data

GeoLibre is a lightweight, cloud-native desktop GIS for visualizing and
analyzing geospatial data, built on MapLibre with deck.gl for 3D and
point-cloud overlays. It loads vector and raster files, web services, 3D
Tiles, MBTiles, and cloud-native formats, and is extensible through a plugin
ecosystem.
GeoLibre v3.10.1 fixes the desktop app crashing at startup in v3.10.0 on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It also keeps offline basemap packages across restarts in the native apps, labels the sides of selected polygons with their lengths, and keeps imported data on iOS. It brings together 13 pull requests from 2 contributors. Thank you to everyone who helped!

## Highlights

• **Desktop startup fix**：GeoLibre Desktop 3.10.0 closed immediately after launch on every platform, because the new auto-updater was switched on without its configuration. The updater now stays off until it is configured, so the app opens normally again. CI now launches the desktop app on every change to catch this kind of failure before a release.
• **Offline basemap packages that last**：in the native apps, Offline Basemap saves extracted and opened PMTiles into app-managed storage that survives a restart, with verify, rename, export, and delete. It can also extract an area and zoom range from a local MBTiles file into the same catalog. See [Native offline packages](https://geolibre.app/native-offline-packages/).
• **Edge lengths on selected polygons**：**Edit → Show edge lengths** labels each side of the selected polygons with its length, measured corner to corner, so a parcel's frontage or depth reads at a glance. It works on the MapLibre and Mapbox maps. See [Attribute Table](https://geolibre.app/user-guide/attribute-table/).
• **Refreshable SQL query snapshots**：Python's `Map.add_sql_query_layer` and the matching MCP tool author a SQL Workspace query layer with an embedded result, and **Refresh** in the app re-runs the query against the project's other layers. See [MCP server](https://geolibre.app/mcp/).
• **Imported data stays put on iOS**：GeoPackage, MBTiles, raster, and GeoJSON imports are copied into app-managed storage, so projects reopen with their data after a restart. See [iOS](https://geolibre.app/ios/).

## Download

Launch GeoLibre Web at https://web.geolibre.app, or get the desktop and mobile apps from https://geolibre.app/downloads/ (or the assets below).
